tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i rten bca' ba sogs la mkho ba'i sngags byang bzhugs/1$0000300 na maḥpad+ma shrī he ru kā ya/ rgyu sngags ni hūm̐ yig go /bzlas pa ni hrīḥbadz+ra kro ta sogs so// dbang sdud sngags ni/ oṃ hrīḥhrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛta wa shaṃ ku ru hrī: ha ya gṛ wa wa shaṃ ku ru hrī: tsan+dhe shwa ri wa shaṃ ku ru hrī: pad+ma rā ga wa shaṃ ku ru hrī: hrīḥdabang wa shaṃ ma na ya hrī hrīṃḥdzaḥdza: rā ga dun dun: dgug pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha tsan+dha rā ga pad+mān+ta kṛta ha ya gṝ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: ma mā shwa ri pad+ma rak+ṣa bh+yo kro dha thum ril: rak+ṣa srog la bh+yo: nṛ aṃ ku sha dzaḥdza: srog khug sa ma ya dza: drag sngags bdun pa ni/ oṃ hrīḥpad+ma bhan dha hrīḥdabang*/ hrīḥtsan dha rak+ṣa srog la rbad/ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛta snying la rbad/ hrīḥha ya gh+rī wa mā ra ya rbad/ hrīḥpad mo dha ra rā ga mā ra ya rbad/ ma ma trag shig tsit+ta la rbad bh+yo: kro dha rak+ṣa dgra bo'i srog la mā ra ya rbad/ rbad nan bh+yoḥ thun sngags ni/ hrīḥha ya gh+rī wa rak+ṣa rbad thun sod/ pad+mān+ta kṛta dgra bo'i snying la thun rbad/ ma ma rak+ṣa dgra bo'i srog la thun rbad/ rag mo tsha la dun snying la khos rbad/ kro dha rak+ṣa dha ra dgra bo'i snying la thun mā ra ya rbad/ zlog pa'i sngags/ hrīḥpad+ma ma hā shrī he ru ka badz+ra gh+rī wa ha ya kro dha badz+ra ma ma kro ta pa ṭa tsa na rak+ṣa ma ma shwa ri sha tra tro he krid krid/ pad+ma shrī he ru kaḥ shad shad dzaḥphaṭa/ dgra bo'i tsit+ta sa ma ya thun rbad/ srog la mā ra ya rbad/ mā ra ya sod/ ma hā ba la pad+ma krid/ suṃ maṃ khaṃ baṃ s+t+waṃ bha ya nan/ thog 'beb sngags/ hrīḥraṃ wa shaṃ ku ru pad+ma bhan+dha dha/ pad+mo dha ya/ tsan+dha rā ga /pad+ma te dza dz+wa la raṃ/ ma ma shwa ri trag rak+ṣa/ khrag la rngubs/ dz+wa la raṃ/ rā hu la si si dza: badz+ra yak+ṣa dz+wa la raṃ/ ma ma khrag la mu sha dz+wa la raṃ/

ma ma khrag la mu sha ma bh+yoḥ tsa ra mu sha dz+wa la raṃ/ badz+ra shad shad/ dgra bo 'khor dang bcas pa'i srog la rbad/ raṃ thog thog gnam lcags ur mo dgra bo'i srog la bh+yoḥbh+yoḥ mā ra ya rbad/ phobs phobs/ ser ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta phrom phrom/ ha ya ghī/ phrom phrom/ ma ma trag rak+ṣa phrom phrom/ hu lu hu lu phrom phrom/ badz+ra rak+ṣa ga te phrom phrom/ ma ra tsa sha phrom phrom/ hrīl hril shar shar drag tu hril bh+yoḥ hūm̐ la phrom/ rā hu la badz+ra yak+ṣa ma snyil/ sa ma khrag hril shar lo thog la phaub/ ma hā khrag la mu sham/ snying tsa sha ma ma bh+yoḥ ma ma rā tsa sha hril/ 'u ya ma tri sib bh+yoḥ lo thog la phob/ oṃ hrīḥwā shaṃ ku ru pad+ma shrī he ru ka ha ya gh+ṝ wa/ pad+ma rā ga tsi nra hri nā ga shu la/ de wī trig nan/ lo thog la bha ri sha ya rbad/ ha na ha na shar phob ya/
zhes pa rnams nyer mkho'i slad du pod gzhung las phyungs pa dge/ //
